goal: Give every VII world a distinctive, polished, image-led landing with simple actions and dedicated backend control, without regressing existing discovery flows.

intent_model.literal_request: Make hourly rooms, providers and every world page unique like the spa page, with a title, imagery and a high-quality experience.
intent_model.implied_outcome: A coherent multi-world product where each world immediately communicates its purpose and next action, yet remains fast, easy and editable by the team.
likely_rejections: Pages are cloned rather than distinct
The admin cannot control the new content
Publication is claimed without live proof

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Inventory the full public world family and improve every generic member while documenting already-distinct members.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: Completion requires a passed route matrix, not a sample page.

cognitive_flow.current_layer: Recognize the selected world and its strongest promise.
cognitive_flow.current_decision: Choose a relevant quick path or start the world's existing search.
cognitive_flow.next_action: Move directly into filtered results or the primary world flow.

natural_destination: Public VII world routes and /admin/content-studio on the exact deployed release.

facts.claim: The spa landing is the approved visual-quality precedent.
Corporate and gift-card routes already have distinctive specialist heroes.
Hourly and providers currently share the generic WorldLanding hero.

assumptions.claim: Existing catalog and trail images are the safest source for truthful world visuals.
assumptions.validation: Trace every rendered hero image to an existing published item and preserve its item name as alt context.

in_scope: distinctive hero treatments for generic discovery worlds
responsive, accessibility, performance and regression tests
out_of_scope: Rebuilding already-distinct corporate and gift-card flows
invariants: Existing search and catalog results remain functional
Existing URLs, canonical metadata and structured data remain stable
No image is presented as a real place unless sourced from that place's existing data
Home, spa and events approved work is preserved

requirements.statement: Every discovery world must open with a polished, recognizably distinct title, supporting copy and verified visual story.
Each opening must expose an obvious next action and preserve the world's existing search and result flow.
requirements.source: User request and VII feedback standard

requirements.statement: Editors must be able to manage each world's landing content and imagery independently through the existing versioned Content Studio workflow.
The affected family must remain fast, responsive, accessible, correctly localized and SEO-safe.
Publication status must be based on direct evidence from the exact production release.
requirements.source: User standing publication instruction and ADIR-QA-001

acceptance_checks.setup: Open each world route on the candidate build.
acceptance_checks.action: Inspect the first screen on desktop and 390px mobile.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Each route presents a world-specific title, composition, palette and truthful imagery with no generic unfinished hero.

acceptance_checks.setup: Load each changed route with JavaScript enabled.
acceptance_checks.action: Use the primary search or quick path and return with browser back.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The action gives immediate feedback, reaches the correct world results and returns without a broken or stale state.

acceptance_checks.setup: Open Content Studio as an authorized editor.
acceptance_checks.action: Edit a representative world landing, save, reload, preview, publish and reopen its public page.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The saved version persists, preview is accurate, publication is audited and only the selected world changes publicly.

acceptance_checks.setup: Enter an unsafe or malformed image/link value.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Validation blocks the unsafe value with a clear field-level explanation and preserves the previous published content.

acceptance_checks.setup: Render a world with no optional quick links or missing optional presentation override.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: A useful default hero and existing catalog flow render without empty boxes, broken images or layout collapse.

acceptance_checks.setup: Force a content-store read failure in test scope.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The safe built-in world presentation renders and the user can continue to search.

acceptance_checks.action: Open every changed production URL and the admin route with a release marker.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The exact deployed version shows the verified landing family and no prior version is mistaken for the new release.

authorization_boundary: Implementation, push and publication are authorized. No purchases, new media licenses or unrelated live-data changes.
